entities.name: Korozda
entities.description: An immense circular maze of fungus-encrusted ruins around the Golgari guildhall Svogthos in the Undercity of Ravnica.

entities.name: Golgari
entities.description: The guild whose lair is Korozda.

entities.name: Penvar, the Hanging Keep
entities.description: A castle fixed upside down above Korozda's entrance.

entities.name: Jarad vod Savo
entities.description: Golgari guildmaster who made the maze his lair.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Moved the court back into Svogthos and later compleated the Golgari.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The war during which allies crossed Korozda.

entities.name: Storrev
entities.description: Received the travellers and led them into the cathedral.

entities.name: Dreadhorde
entities.description: Invading army during the War of the Spark.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which Korozda was upended.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: Upended Korozda from above, cracking Svogthos.

events.summary: After Svogthir and Savra died, the Golgari abandoned Svogthos for Korozda, which became Jarad's lair.
events.quote: the maze became the lair of the new guildmaster Jarad vod Savo

events.summary: After Jarad's death Vraska moved the court back into Svogthos and built a throne of petrified opponents.
events.quote: Vraska moved the court back into Svogthos after the death of Jarad

events.summary: In the War of the Spark Ral, Kaya, Teyo and Araithia crossed Korozda to Svogthos; Storrev led them in to seek aid against the Dreadhorde.
events.quote: They were allowed to pass through unharmed and were approached by Storrev

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion, Realmbreaker upended Korozda, cracking Svogthos.
events.quote: Realmbreaker upended Korozda from above, cracking Svogthos.

relations.quote: surrounds the Golgari guildhall Svogthos in the Undercity of Ravnica
the new guildmaster Jarad vod Savo
